title: LaLa-World: Scaling Latent World Models with Natural Language Actions
title_zh: LaLa-World：基于自然语言动作扩展潜在世界模型

paragraphs.en: 总结：本文提出LaLa-World，一种以自然语言为动作接口的潜在世界模型，通过联合训练实现高效规划与机器人策略微调，性能优异且成本大幅降低。 This paper shows that JEPA-style latent world models (LWMs) can learn across diverse domains and data sources by adopting the language-conditioned interface of video generation models. We establish this approach as an effective and efficient basis for planning with imagination and downstream policy fine-tuning. To this end, we introduce LaLa-World, a Language-conditioned Latent World model that learns from simulation and robot trajectories together with broader image and video data. Two designs make this work. First, we describe both numerical actions and visual changes in language, enabling joint training of a single future predictor across heterogeneous datasets. Second, we build the predictor on a language model, allowing it to interpret language conditions while predicting future latent states. The resulting predictor achieves higher average MPC planning performance than existing LWMs trained separately for each domain or task. Adding image and video data further improves average planning performance and robustness to action phrasing. In a matched comparison with an RAEv2-based video generation model baseline, LaLa-World reaches comparable planning performance with $6\times$ less training cost and $13.9\times$ faster planning. Beyond planning, the pretrained LaLa-World serves as an initialization for LaLa-Policy, which jointly predicts actions and future visual representations. LaLa-Policy performs competitively with Cosmos Policy on LIBERO and RoboCasa, with up to $5.5\times$ faster inference.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：本文提出LaLa-World，一种以自然语言为动作接口的潜在世界模型，通过联合训练实现高效规划与机器人策略微调，性能优异且成本大幅降低。 本文表明，JEPA风格的潜在世界模型（LWM）可以通过采用视频生成模型的语言条件接口，跨多种领域和数据源进行学习。 我们确立了这一方法作为通过想象进行规划以及下游策略微调的高效且有效的基础。 为此，我们提出LaLa-World，一种语言条件潜在世界模型，它从仿真和机器人轨迹以及更广泛的图像和视频数据中共同学习。 两项设计使这一工作成为可能。 首先，我们用语言描述数值动作和视觉变化，使单一的未来预测器能够在异构数据集上进行联合训练。 其次，我们将该预测器构建在语言模型之上，使其在预测未来潜在状态的同时能够理解语言条件。 由此得到的预测器在平均MPC规划性能上超越了为每个领域或任务单独训练的现有LWM。 加入图像和视频数据进一步提升了平均规划性能以及对动作表述方式的鲁棒性。 在与基于RAEv2的视频生成模型基线的对等比较中，LaLa-World以$6\times$更低的训练成本和$13.9\times$更快的规划速度达到了相当的规划性能。 除规划之外，预训练的LaLa-World还可作为LaLa-Policy的初始化，后者联合预测动作和未来视觉表征。 LaLa-Policy在LIBERO和RoboCasa上与Cosmos Policy表现相当，推理速度最高快$5.5\times$。
